description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the order tracking screen in a food delivery app, including UI components such as status stepper, progress indicator, and order details.

classes.name: OrderTrackingScreen
classes.description: StatelessWidget that displays the current status and details of a particular order.

classes.name: _StatusStepper
classes.description: A widget that visually indicates the current status of an order using a stepper component.

methods.name: _statusLabel
methods.description: Converts an OrderStatus enum value into a human-readable string label.

methods.name: _indexFor
methods.description: Maps an OrderStatus enum to its corresponding step index in the stepper.
